mapper.select: SELECT L.COMPANY_CODE, L.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, L.PASSWORD AS dbPassword, L.FAIL_COUNT, L.STATUS, L.LOCKED_DATE, L.LAST_LOGIN, U.ROLE_CODE FROM TB_LOGIN_MASTER L JOIN TB_USER_MASTER U ON L.COMPANY_CODE = U.COMPANY_CODE AND L.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE L.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND L.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT L.COMPANY_CODE, L.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, L.PASSWORD AS dbPassword, L.FAIL_COUNT, L.STATUS, L.LOCKED_DATE, L.LAST_LOGIN, U.ROLE_CODE FROM TB_LOGIN_MASTER L JOIN TB_USER_MASTER U ON L.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LOGIN_MASTER SET FAIL_COUNT = FAIL_COUNT + 1, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE TB_LOGIN_MASTER SET FAIL_COUNT = #{failCount}, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE TB_LOGIN_MASTER SET STATUS = 'LOCKED', LOCKED_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE TB_LOGIN_MASTER SET FAIL_COUNT = 0, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE TB_LOGIN_MASTER SET LAST_LOGIN = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE TB_LOGIN_MASTER SET FAIL_COUNT = 0, LAST_LOGIN = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE TB_LOGIN_MASTER SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', FAIL_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_DATE = NULL, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.company_code, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.dept, d.dept_name, u.job_title, FN_FIND_CODENAME('0C', u.job_title) AS job_title_name, u.position, FN_FIND_CODENAME('0D', u.position) AS position_name, u.user_photo, u.role_code FROM tb_user_master u JOIN tb_dept_master d ON u.dept = d.dept_code WHERE u.company_code = #{companyCode} AND u.user_id = #{userId}
